GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 072 (1 Jun 48) CPC/FP
(SCAPIN-1902/1)
APO 500
31 July 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Reclassification of Secret Patents and Utility Models.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 072 (1 Jun 48) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1902, 1 June 1948, subject, “Licensing of Government-Owned Patents,” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Patents and utility models hitherto classified as secret shall be removed from such classification and henceforth shall be treated in like manner as all other patents and utility models in the records of the Patent Office.
3. Pending applications for patents or utillity models hitherto classified as secret shall be removed from such classification and shall be processed in like manner as all other such applications.
4. Patents and utility models hitherto classified as secret and registered in the name of the Japanese Government, its agencies or subdivisions, shall be subject to licensing under the provisions of reference 1 above, provided that they do not relate to weapons or means of war.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
